cases.question: In RenderEmployeeCommandViewData, does the permanent-address ward list always use the district ID?
expected_facts: The branch requires non-null detail and a populated province field.
When allowNew is true, the province value is passed to WardBaseList.
Otherwise, the district value is used only when populated.
If the province is absent, this branch does not populate that ViewData key even if a district exists.
forbidden_claims: The setting is currently enabled in production.
The called helper necessarily interprets every argument as a district ID.
This rendering branch updates stored employee addresses.
cases.rationale: Tests guarded read/render behavior without relying on personal-update routing or persistence.

No export can occur anywhere else in the application.
The view or ExcelComponent constructor has no side effects.

cases.question: In delete mode, what prevents OrganizationPositionCommand from removing a position, and what happens when its ID is absent?
expected_facts: Mode 2 first resolves the position by model.Id.
A matching EmployeeOrganizations row for the resolved organization/job-position pair causes an early error result.
The predicate contains no additional employee-status or concurrency filter.
Without such a match, the position is removed, changes are saved, and a successful result is returned.
An absent position falls through to the method's final null.
forbidden_claims: Only currently active employees participate in the guard.
The check is against model.OrganizationId rather than the resolved position's organization.
Missing IDs return successful deletion.
The application-level check proves race-free database enforcement.
cases.rationale: Captures a concrete guard, its exact lookup keys, and the missing-record path.

cases.question: Does listing an existing bidding package in CreateFullOrganization always transfer it to the newly created organization?
expected_facts: The loop runs only when model.Packages is non-null.
Each item resolves an existing package by ID.
Assignment occurs only if the package exists and OrganizationId equals zero.
Missing packages and packages with nonzero organization IDs receive no assignment in this block.
forbidden_claims: A package already belonging to another organization is transferred.
A missing package is created here.
Skipped items produce an explicit error in this block.
Zero's broader business meaning or database constraints are established.
cases.rationale: Tests a narrowly supported association guard rather than assuming request membership authorizes reassignment.

cases.question: Do CreateFullOrganization and EditFullOrganization overwrite KhoangCach identically when their distance lookup finds an existing row?

snippets: var od = Context.OrganizationDistances.FirstOrDefault(x => x.OrgId == d.Id && x.KhuVuc == item.KhuVuc) ??

expected_facts: Both blocks look up a distance by organization and region.
In creation, the KhoangCach assignment is inside the fallback initializer; an existing returned object does not receive that assignment.
In editing, assignment occurs after lookup/fallback, so it applies to an existing or newly constructed object.
Both blocks add objects whose Id is zero and call SaveChanges within the loop.
forbidden_claims: Creation always overwrites an existing distance.
The two blocks have identical assignment semantics.
Source alone proves duplicate rows, deployed uniqueness constraints, or an observed production defect.
cases.rationale: Distinguishes initializer-only flow from an unconditional post-lookup assignment.

cases.question: Can the selected hierarchy-rebuild code certify that every active organization tree is repaired while inactive descendants are never traversed?

snippets: var Orgs = Context.Organizations.Where(x => x.Status >= 0 && x.Stopped == false).ToList();
var Parent = Orgs.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ParentId == null && x.Status >= 0 && x.Stopped == false);

expected_facts: The outer method materializes active, non-stopped organizations and selects one root using FirstOrDefault.
It does not explicitly iterate over all roots.
Recursive entry from an immediate child is conditional on finding children in the outer filtered list.
Once entered, the helper queries children by ParentId without repeating status/stopped filters.
Actual coverage depends on graph and entry conditions; source does not prove a single root or acyclic live graph.
forbidden_claims: Every root is processed.
Every recursive query excludes inactive/stopped rows.
Inactive descendants are necessarily touched on every invocation.
Successful return alone proves complete hierarchy repair.
cases.rationale: Preserves filter differences across a recursive boundary without inventing runtime topology.

cases.question: Can this source establish the live portal hostname and prove that an MST-notification success response means every targeted employee received an email?

expected_facts: The action requests MST-null records with unlimited results.
It reads template code 00365 and obtains domain from settings, not a hostname literal.
It writes a body file and conditionally invokes EmailTaskCommand for a populated company email.
The invocation's return value is not checked here.
A non-null empty collection can reach the final success-message return without processing recipients.
Current source does not establish deployed settings, template contents, worker execution, SMTP acceptance, or receipt.

Every targeted employee receives a task or email.
The success text confirms delivery.
